# IncenseHub (IncenseHub)

> A quiet, research-led English-language knowledge platform for Chinese botanical incense: its materials, botanicals, history, terminology, craft and culture.

## Core pages

- [Home](/): editorial homepage for IncenseHub.
- [Chinese Incense (香 / Xiang)](/chinese-incense/): what Chinese incense is — history, the Four Leisure Arts, and the way of incense (香道).
- [About IncenseHub](/about/): the platform's scope, editorial standards and provenance policy.
- [Blog & Guides](/blog/): the full article index — materials, history, craft and authentication.
- [Contact](/contact/): editorial corrections, sourcing questions and privacy requests.

## Machine-readable data

- [Ingredient dataset](https://data.incensehub.org/datasets/ingredients.json): 150 ingredient entities (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).
- [Terminology dataset](https://data.incensehub.org/datasets/terminology.json): 249 Chinese–English incense terms (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).
- [Relationship dataset](https://data.incensehub.org/datasets/relationships.json): 150 / 806 entity records (typed edges) (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).
- [Comparison dataset](https://data.incensehub.org/datasets/comparisons.json): 17 comparison profiles (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).
- [Material dataset](https://data.incensehub.org/datasets/materials.json): 15 functional materials (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).
- [Form dataset](https://data.incensehub.org/datasets/forms.json): 12 incense forms (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).
- [Technique dataset](https://data.incensehub.org/datasets/techniques.json): 12 incense techniques (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).
- [Aroma dataset](https://data.incensehub.org/datasets/aroma.json): 10 aroma families (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).

## Machine-readable markdown

Clean markdown variants of the data-driven pages are generated at build time (`.md` endpoints) for LLMs and AI agents. Each file carries a YAML frontmatter (title, description, canonical, updated), an H1, a one-sentence definition, core data tables and source links — with no navigation, footer or JavaScript noise — and links back to its human-readable HTML page.

Endpoint patterns:

- `/ingredients/{slug}.md` — 150 ingredient entity pages
- `/blog/{slug}.md` — 115 blog guides
- `/chinese-incense.md` — Chinese incense pillar page

Example URLs:

- [Agarwood](https://incensehub.org/ingredients/agarwood.md)
- [Sandalwood](https://incensehub.org/ingredients/sandalwood.md)
- [What is Chinese incense?](https://incensehub.org/chinese-incense.md)
- [Agarwood grading guide](https://incensehub.org/blog/agarwood-grading-guide.md)
- [Incense safety guide](https://incensehub.org/blog/incense-safety-guide.md)

## AI content notes

- Entity pages expose machine-readable definitions (Chinese term, pinyin, scientific name, type, aroma profile).
- Traditional knowledge and modern evidence are labeled separately.
- No fabricated reviews, ratings, prices or authors appear on this site.
